page.note: template_png is the ORIGINAL certificate background with the 4 dynamic content areas whited-out (redacted). Everything else (logo, QR code, signature, static labels, decorative shapes) is preserved pixel-perfect from the real design. Compose final certificates by pasting this PNG as the page background, then drawing the dynamic text on top at the given point-coordinates, scaled to whatever DPI you render at (pixel = pt * dpi / 72).

fonts.note: Arimo is metric-compatible with Arial/Arial-Bold (the fonts used in the real PDF: 'ArialMT' and 'Arial-BoldMT'), OFL licensed, bundled locally so the app works fully offline.

name.note: Right edge capped at 762 to stay clear of the blue chevron decoration that starts at x=764.5 for y in [132,288]. Box is generous vertically (120pt) to allow the Ukrainian and/or English name to wrap to multiple lines and shrink font size if very long.

title.note: Static label above this box ('пройшов(ла) тренінг на тему:' / 'has passed training on the subject:') stays fixed at y ~248-273 and is NOT part of this box / NOT redacted (kept from template). This box only holds the dynamic training title. Right edge 800 and bottom 452 are chosen to stay clear of decorations and the 'Бізнес-тренер' static row which starts at y=460.

static_elements_already_baked_into_templ: Logo cube icon + 'КВАДРАТ ЗДАНЕВИЧА' vertical text (top-left, on purple panel)
'пройшов(ла) тренінг на тему:' / 'has passed training on the subject:' label
'Бізнес-тренер' / 'Business-trainer' label + signature image + 'Михайло Зданевич' / 'Mykhailo Zdanevych' (trainer name is fixed, NOT an argument)
All decorative shapes: purple panel, white diagonal stripes, yellow shapes, blue chevrons, light-blue rectangles, yellow dot grid, bottom-right diagonal hatch lines
sizing_rule: If a name or title line's rendered width would exceed the box width at base_size_pt, first try wrapping onto additional line(s) within the box height; if it still overflows (too many lines or a single word wider than the box), progressively shrink the font size (e.g. in 0.5pt steps) until it fits both width and the box's vertical space. Keep the same shrink/wrap logic independently for the Ukrainian and English variants of a field so one long language doesn't shrink the other unnecessarily.
